risk_assertions_ADD.citation_text: NCI BRCA Fact Sheet 2022; BRCA Challenge Consortium (BCAC). Cumulative risk >60% vs ~13% baseline.
NCI BRCA Fact Sheet 2022; BCAC. Cumulative risk >60% vs ~13% baseline.
NCI BRCA Fact Sheet 2022. Cumulative pancreatic cancer risk ≤5% for BRCA1 carriers vs ~1.7% baseline.
NCI BRCA Fact Sheet 2022. Cumulative pancreatic cancer risk 5%-10% for BRCA2 carriers vs ~1.7% baseline.

de la Chapelle A, 2005; NCCN Genetic Colon Cancer Guidelines 2023. MLH1 carriers: CRC risk to age 70 = 40-80% (male) / 30-50% (female) vs ~5% general population. OR≈25 derived from midpoint cumulative risk comparison.
de la Chapelle A, 2005; NCCN 2023. MSH2 carriers: CRC risk to age 70 = 45-80% (male) / 35-60% (female). OR≈28 derived from midpoint cumulative risk comparison.
NCCN 2023; Jenkins MA 2006. MSH6 carriers: CRC cumulative risk 10-25% to age 70 vs ~5% general population. OR≈5 derived from midpoint.
NCCN 2023; Slack J 2019. PMS2 carriers: CRC cumulative risk 8-15% to age 70 vs ~5% general population. OR≈3 derived from midpoint.
NCCN 2023. MSH2 carriers: gastric cancer cumulative risk 4-8% to age 70 vs ~1% general population.
NCCN 2023. MSH2 carriers: ovarian cancer cumulative risk 10-17% to age 70 vs ~1.1% general population. OR≈12 derived from midpoint.
NCCN 2023. MLH1 carriers: ovarian cancer cumulative risk 8-14% to age 70 vs ~1.1% general population. OR≈9 derived from midpoint.
CAPS Consortium 2020; Familial Pancreatic Cancer (FPC) literature. First-degree relative with pancreatic cancer increases risk ~2-3 fold; higher with multiple affected relatives.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Replaced He 2015 single-study value with Pang 2023 meta-analysis (83 studies, n=9546)
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Pang BY et al., Ann Med 2023, PMID:36476015
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: Meta-analysis of 83 studies (n=9546). AFP alone: sensitivity 61%, specificity 87%, AUC=0.78. Combined with AFP-L3+DCP raises AUC to 0.91.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Replaced self-set '补充调研文档.md' source with Ben-Ami 2024 (Gut) validation cohort data
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Ben-Ami R et al., Gut 2024, PMID:38123998
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CA19-9 in early pancreatic cancer: AUC=0.82 (95%CI 0.72-0.92) in validation set. Sensitivity range 70-80%, specificity 80-90% across train/test/validation cohorts. Not recommended for general population screening.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Updated to DOR-derived values from Fu 2019 meta-analysis (NSCLC, lung squamous)
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Fu L et al., Int J Biol Markers 2019; Cui C et al., J Cancer Res Ther 2014
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: Lung squamous: sensitivity 72%, specificity 94%, DOR=27.30 (Fu 2019). NSCLC: DOR=22.57 (Cui 2014). Significantly higher performance than Wieskopf 1995 estimates.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Replaced self-set value; CEA in pleural effusion context for lung adenocarcinoma has DOR=47.26 (Cheng 2022)
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Shi HZ et al., Respirology 2008; Cheng C et al., Expert Rev Respir Med 2022
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CEA for lung adenocarcinoma (serum): sensitivity 54%, specificity 94%, DOR=22.5 (Shi 2008). Pleural effusion context higher at DOR=47.26. Using serum values for general screening context.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Replaced self-set value with literature range from Vassilakopoulos 2001

detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: SCCAg for NSCLC: sensitivity 32-55%, specificity 78-100% (Vassilakopoulos 2001). HR=5.823 (3.30-10.28) as prognostic marker. Current value 0.45/0.85 within range; source updated.

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Clarify early vs metastatic stage applicability from Fu 2016 data
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Fu Y et al., Med Sci Monit 2016; evidence_20260527.md sec 1.3
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CA15-3 for early-stage breast cancer: sensitivity <20%. Metastatic: 50-70%. Downgraded from 0.35 to 0.20 to reflect early-screening context. High sensitivity in metastatic monitoring is not applicable for primary screening.

detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CEA for early breast cancer: <20% sensitivity. Metastatic: 30-50%. Using early-stage value for primary screening context. CA15-3 is preferred primary marker.

detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CA19-9 for CRC: sensitivity range 20-40%. FIT is preferred CRC screening tool. CA19-9 used as supplementary indicator.

detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CA19-9 for gastric cancer: sensitivity 20-40%. CA72-4 is preferred gastric marker (sensitivity 20-40%, specificity > CEA).

detection_performance_UPDATE._reason: Source citation added; CA19-9 is secondary marker for ovarian cancer
detection_performance_UPDATE.source_id: Evidence_20260527.md sec 1.7; Ghose et al., Ther Adv Med Oncol 2024
detection_performance_UPDATE.notes: CA19-9 is a secondary/supplementary marker for ovarian cancer. CA125 (+HE4 ROMA index) is primary. CA19-9 alone has limited specificity.

detection_performance_ADD.test_name: 神经元特异性烯醇化酶 NSE
detection_performance_ADD.source_id: Huang L et al., Oncotarget 2017, PMID:28969076
detection_performance_ADD.notes: Meta-analysis: sensitivity 68.8%, specificity 92.1%, DOR=25.83 (95%CI 17.49-38.14). Primarily a marker for small-cell lung cancer (SCLC). Asian subgroup: sensitivity 59.0%, specificity 90.1%.

detection_performance_ADD.test_name: 胃泌素释放肽前体 ProGRP
detection_performance_ADD.source_id: Wang H et al., J Cancer Res Ther 2016
detection_performance_ADD.notes: ProGRP for SCLC: sensitivity 64%, specificity 94%, DOR=40.98 (95%CI 27.77-60.64). Combined ProGRP+NSE: sensitivity 88.9%, specificity 72.82%. Highest performance among SCLC markers.

detection_performance_ADD.source_id: Yu et al., Int J Cancer 2018; ASCCP Guidelines 2019
detection_performance_ADD.notes: HPV DNA primary screening: sensitivity >95%, specificity ~85%. HPV-16/18 genotyping accounts for ~80% of cervical cancers. Combined with p16/Ki-67 dual stain for triage of non-16/18 high-risk types.

imaging_findings_ADD.citation_text: AASLD guidelines. Suspicious liver lesion on ultrasound: malignancy PPV approximately 50-70%. Applies to non-cirrhotic background; cirrhotic liver with LI-RADS 4-5 features warrants dedicated HCC workup.
imaging_findings_ADD.next_step: 增强CT或MRI进一步评估；肝硬化背景建议按LI-RADS分级管理；多学科会诊

imaging_findings_ADD.citation_text: Multiple studies. Suspicious pancreatic mass on CT/MRI: malignancy PPV approximately 40-60%. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is most common; cystic lesions with high-risk features (mural nodules, dilated MPD) also confer elevated risk.
imaging_findings_ADD.next_step: 多学科会诊（胰腺外科/肿瘤内科）；EUS-FNA活检评估；CA19-9+CEA联合检测；评估手术可切除性

evidence_quality_flags.note: Combined BRCA1/2 OR=6.0 is higher than the separate BRCA1 (5.0) and BRCA2 (4.0) entries added above. This is intentional: when the mutation type is unknown, use the combined factor. When the specific mutation is known, the new separate assertions should be used instead. Recommend adding a mutual-exclusion note in the ontology.
